name: 3D Gaussian Splatting Rasterization (GPU)
definition: A torch.autograd.Function implementing the forward and backward passes for Gaussian rasterization, handling argument restructuring and buffer management.
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting Rasterization (GPU) is a differentiable CUDA method that efficiently renders millions of 3D Gaussians by sorting them by tile and depth for parallel alpha blending, maintaining exact gradients for all parameters.
